subject: SF
name: South France — pen and light wash

styleSelection.reason: The requested urban sketch uses confident pen structure over transparent local-colour washes. Roofs, eaves and branching trees are carried by fine black ink; connected canopy and wall value masses stay paint.

families.referenceCue: Sunlit yellow limestone terraces on the upper left; long pale planes, darker doorway.
Small distant houses embedded in olive trees; sparse roof junctions and pale ochre walls.
Blue-grey far hillside at upper right: pale, low contrast and subordinate.
Narrow pointed vertical cypresses; dark green paint bodies with restrained pen at the silhouette.
Interlocking olive-green and blue-grey canopy masses, lit upper surfaces and connected cool undersides.
Terracotta roofs on the right; crisp roof/eave junctions, warm light walls, violet shaded sides and small dark recesses.
Large yellow-green crown with a branching dark trunk reaching the lower edge; foliage is a connected wash and branches belong to ink.
Pale diagonal garden paths, low olive bushes and two small branching trees; broken pale gaps connect the hillside.

reserves.reason: Tiny limestone doorway-jamb glint; bare paper
Small chalk path light beside the focal houses; bare paper
Small pale foreground path fleck; bare paper
